PullRequest.Title: Chat: disable HydraFusion for free users
PullRequest.Body:
Disable HydraFusion as a selectable routing model for Copilot Free users in both the new tabbed picker and the legacy model picker.

Both picker implementations now use a shared entitlement filter that removes the live HydraFusion model for Free entitlement, allowing the existing unavailable-model handling to present it as a disabled upgrade row. Paid plans and Auto tiers remain unchanged. The tabbed picker retains its unfiltered model list and refreshes when entitlement changes, so an open picker immediately reflects resolution to Free.

Findings.ConfidenceRationale: The new listener, synchronous per-key event source, unbuffered multi-key update, visible-only refresh guard, and DOM/layout work are all directly traced. Exact milliseconds depend on catalogue size and how often account state changes, which limits severity rather than mechanism confidence.
Findings.PerformanceResource: model-catalogue CPU work, action-list DOM updates, and synchronous layout reads
Findings.PerformanceScaling: For each watched context key changed by one account snapshot, the listener rebuilds work proportional to the model/provider catalogue; a normal Unknown-to-Free update changes at least signedOut and planFree, and SKU/organization changes can add more serial rebuilds.
Findings.PerformanceOutcome: redundant synchronous list reconstruction and layout on the UI thread, increasing picker latency and risking a visible frame hitch for larger model/provider catalogues
Findings.PreviousBehavior: An already-open tabbed picker did not rebuild in response to entitlement context-key updates.
Findings.ChangedBehavior: Every broad entitlement event now synchronously refreshes the visible picker and passes `models`, which additionally recomputes destinations and sections for all destinations before refreshing the active action list.
Findings.CausalDiffEvidence: The added RIGHT-side listener at line 143 invokes `refresh(this._models)` for every `onDidChangeEntitlement` emission; before this line, entitlement context-key emissions did not refresh `TabbedModelPicker`.
Findings.Title: Coalesce entitlement events before rebuilding the picker
Findings.Impact: If entitlement resolves or account metadata updates while the model picker is open, one logical update can rebuild and relayout the full picker multiple times; larger BYOK/provider catalogues amplify the UI-thread work and can make the open picker hitch.
Findings.Evidence: `ChatEntitlementService.onDidChangeEntitlement` is derived from changes to all plan keys plus signedOut, canSignUp, organizations, internal, and SKU. `ChatEntitlementContext.updateContextSync` sets those keys separately without `bufferChangeEvents`, and `ContextKeyService.setContext` fires synchronously for each changed key. Thus one snapshot such as Unknown-to-Free emits at least once for signedOut and once for planFree. Each call reaches `TabbedModelPicker.refresh`, rebuilds every destination's sections because `models` is supplied, then `TabbedActionListWidget.refreshActiveList` rebuilds sizing and active lists, updates DOM items, and reads `body.offsetHeight` for layout.
Findings.Recommendation: Track the last effective gating state (`entitlement === Free`) and schedule/coalesce one refresh after the context-key update settles; skip refreshes when that boolean did not change.

Scenarios.Scenario: Open the legacy model picker for a Free user
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The model catalogue is filtered in memory before unavailable/selectable sections are built and the action list can render.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: The live model catalogue and curated control-model catalogue; filtering adds one O(models) pass only for Free entitlement.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Fully synchronous and serial on the UI thread; no queue or limiter is involved.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cache is added or bypassed. Paid plans reuse the original model array; Free plans allocate one filtered array on each picker build.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the helper and sole legacy call site were directly inspected.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Model catalogues vary, but picker opening is user-triggered and the added single linear pass is small relative to the existing section and row construction.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression; one bounded in-memory pass per picker build is proportionate and introduces no expensive boundary.

Scenarios.Scenario: Open or refresh the tabbed model picker with a stable entitlement
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Filtering runs before destination/section construction; opening then renders the active and sizing lists synchronously.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Models across Copilot and user-added providers; the added filter is O(models) only for Free users.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Synchronous UI-thread construction and rendering; refreshes are serialized by event delivery.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The unfiltered catalogue is retained to support later entitlement changes. Non-Free filtering returns the same array; Free filtering allocates a fresh shallow array.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: show, filter, destination, section, and widget-render paths were traced.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: The number of installed BYOK/provider models varies, but the retained state is only one additional array reference and Free's copy is bounded by the existing catalogue.
Scenarios.Verdict: No separate finding; the initial filtering cost and retained reference are bounded and do not materially amplify the existing picker render.

Scenarios.Scenario: Resolve or update entitlement while the tabbed picker remains open
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The new entitlement listener synchronously calls `refresh(this._models)`; each call rebuilds all destination sections, then rebuilds and updates the sizing and active action lists before the picker settles.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Effective cost is O(changed watched entitlement keys × models/providers), followed by action-list DOM updates and layout reads for each emission.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Serial and uncoalesced. A single account snapshot updates watched context keys separately, causing multiple immediate refreshes.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No refresh coalescing or effective-state cache exists. Passing `_models` forces catalogue-dependent recomputation on every emission, including organization/SKU changes that do not alter Free gating.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: Very high: the broad event definition, unbuffered per-key setters, synchronous event firing, refresh call path, DOM update, and layout read were all inspected.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Account updates while the picker is open are less frequent than ordinary picker use, and exact frame cost depends on catalogue size; the duplicate event and layout mechanism is deterministic.
Scenarios.Verdict: Reportable low-severity regression: one logical entitlement update can cause redundant full picker rebuilds and synchronous layouts.

Analysis.Summary: Reviewed all five changed files and traced legacy picker construction, tabbed picker show/refresh lifecycle, entitlement event production, model grouping, action-list DOM updates, and layout. Submitted one missing-coalescing finding for repeated synchronous refreshes from broad per-context-key entitlement events; no subprocess, IPC, filesystem, database, or network boundary is introduced on the changed paths.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
